scope: Durable solver-research evidence assets and queryable evidence interfaces. This registry describes evidence available to research; it does not authorize production use of offline labels.

assets.name: Published level corpus and saved hints
affordances: Compare player-facing puzzle structure with solver behavior.
Mine accepted-path diversity and provenance without re-solving the corpus.
Provide the published source population for solution-space profiles and current solver comparisons.
caveats: Saved hints and known paths are offline labels and may not steer a cold production solve.
Published levels are repeatedly inspected development material, not an untouched generalization sample.

assets.name: Stress corpora, construction witnesses, and generation provenance
affordances: Stratify findings by generator/source rather than treating all hard levels as exchangeable.
Use construction witnesses to establish solvability and localize solver divergence without granting the solver a hint.
Stratify by both generation ancestry and later population-selection history; corpus filenames do not imply distributional independence.
caveats: Construction witnesses prove solvability, not cold solver capability.
Corpus 2 has been heavily mined and is a development/capability laboratory rather than untouched evidence.
Corpus 1 includes 79 current random-uniform rows selected for historical solver success; whole Corpus 1 is not a cross-generator source relative to Corpus 2.
Current Corpus 2 includes 328 survivors from the historical solver-negative random complement plus 1,372 later replacement rows.
Generation provenance and population-selection provenance are separate; a solver-blind generator does not make a later outcome-selected corpus independent.
Rows from the same generator or family may not be independent for a broad claim.

assets.name: Hint discovery provenance
affordances: Ask an explicit evidence-purpose question instead of treating every valid historical discovery as equivalent evidence.
Keep every referee-valid path available as positive-oracle/solution-atlas material while filtering producer/context appropriately for capability or performance claims.
Distinguish witness, human, external, variant-replay and Pathfinder origins from overlapping exhaustive, randomized, isolated, hint-guided and production-retry facets.
Recover exact solver/configuration, work, nodes, termination, seed, forcing, run-context and solver-regime information for historical rediscoveries.
Collapse dependent replay/configuration clouds into conservative within-path dependency strata before interpreting support volume.
Test whether an apparent technique, corpus, solution-profile or current-capability effect is confounded by how and when known solutions were discovered.
caveats: Evidence applicability is query-dependent: one event may be strong atlas/history evidence and inadmissible current-capability evidence.
Coverage differs by corpus/source and legacy entries may have unknown fields; absent legacy booleans remain unknown rather than modern false values.
A stored path can have multiple provenance entries and therefore multiple source memberships; raw event count is not independent support.
Variant replay, witness, external, guided, isolated and exhaustive contexts do not establish current cold Pathfinder capability merely because the path is valid.
Randomization is an orthogonal facet rather than an automatic disqualifier because production repair can be seeded.
Old solver versions are not automatically stale, but current capability/performance use requires audited code/config/scheduler/work equivalence or bounded current replay.
Technique-performance claims require originating-run denominators/failures and comparable work; success-selected hint events alone cannot establish solve rate or relative performance.
Provenance is powerful offline evidence but must not become level-specific runtime steering.

assets.name: Run-linked hint discovery process evidence
affordances: Recover which failed attempts and work preceded an exact stored solution-path discovery without bloating every persisted hint event.
Link success-selected hint history to the owning immutable experiment/run envelope when that envelope exists.
Compare successful discovery process with compact failed-attempt evidence under shared run/protocol/action identities.
caveats: Binding to a hint requires exact complete path equality; no fuzzy level/config/path inference is allowed.
The owning experiment contract remains authoritative for protocol, population, execution and limit semantics; this asset stores only a bounded identity projection.
An unmatched solved row is unavailable join evidence, not a negative statement about hint validity or discovery.
Historical process evidence does not establish current capability merely because the path remains referee-valid.
Parent level remains the default independent unit unless the owning experiment contract declares a different independent unit.
This is offline research evidence and may not become exact-level production steering.

assets.name: Hint harvest selection provenance
affordances: Measure how many already-solved source rows were observed, referee-accepted, persisted as new path/provenance evidence, already represented, or quarantined.
Preserve why solved evidence failed to enter the current hint store instead of silently losing the selection boundary.
Audit whether changes in the hint store reflect producer novelty, persistence deduplication, or reconciliation/quarantine behavior.
caveats: The denominator is success-selected source rows, not the originating attempted solver population.
These manifests cannot estimate solve rate or relative technique performance without joining the originating experiment population/failures.
A referee-accepted row that makes no persistence change usually means equivalent evidence was already represented; it is not a failed discovery.
Quarantined evidence remains historical/forensic material and must not be silently reclassified as current capability.

assets.name: Canonical structural level fingerprint

locations.path: v2 fingerprints computed from canonical level structure; values also occur in provenance context.levelRevision

affordances: Join persisted evidence to a stable structural revision even when field insertion order or hints change.
Detect duplicate/same-structure observations and stale provenance across level revisions.
Provide a forensic join key distinct from corpus position or mutable display metadata.
caveats: The fingerprint is an identity/deduplication primitive, not a legal production nearest-neighbor feature.
Legacy fingerprint versions are migration support; compare through the owning implementation rather than raw-string assumptions.

assets.name: Offline known-solution sample profiles
affordances: Measure sampled path-mode diversity, footprint, objective-satisfaction depth, portal use, turn structure, observed must-cross order agreement, and supported discovery chronology.
Compare solver response with support-aware descriptions of the stored known-solution sample.
Stratify profile summaries by provenance source to expose sampling artifacts.
caveats: Profiles summarize stored known-solution samples and are forbidden direct production-routing inputs.
Use schema-v3 support-aware comparison; unsupported sparse axes are unavailable evidence rather than zero-valued measurements.
Observed single-order agreement does not prove structural rigidity, even when an exhaustive-search provenance event exists.
hasExhaustiveSearchEvent records an event under local conditions and does not prove unrestricted whole-puzzle enumeration or persistence of the complete solution space.
Saturation/plateau interpretation requires adequate dated chronology; incomplete chronology leaves the longitudinal axis unavailable.
Sparse nearest-profile identity remains exploratory and should be independently calibrated before decision-bearing similarity claims.
Similarity may encode family/generator ancestry rather than a causal solver mechanism.

assets.name: Solver determinism fingerprints

locations.path: solver:fingerprint outputs selected by the invoking investigation

affordances: Detect semantic/search-order drift that solve totals can hide.
Separate deterministic behavior changes from pure wall-time changes.
Support before/after regression attribution when implementation or naming migrations touch execution plumbing.
caveats: These fingerprints describe solver behavior, not level geometry or solution-space structure.
Fingerprint parity does not establish generalization or performance value.

assets.name: Current isolated technique × level census and capability map
affordances: Expose rare/exclusive capability, substitutions, inversions, multiplicity, cap/tranche economics, and oracle-frontier headroom.
Define response vectors that can be joined to solution structure, provenance, geometry, variants, or live production behavior.
Distinguish an unavailable capability from a capability that production simply fails to schedule.

Stratify failed cells by exhausted/node-capped/work-capped/deadline-truncated/referee-invalid via the standard compact failure-response summary (manifest.json's failureEvidence.summary; see docs/solver-failure-evidence-disposition.json) instead of collapsing them to solve/no-solve.
caveats: Isolated success is nomination evidence, not automatic production value.
The matrix is heavily mined development evidence and historical technique identities must normalize through current owners.
Raw nodes compare depth within a technique; cross-technique allocation uses workSpent.
The compact failure-response summary's coverageComplete is only trustworthy when built from an externally verified population; a self-derived population reports it as unknown.

assets.name: Current and historical production solver benchmark outcomes

locations.path: reports/stress/** solver benchmark and refresh outputs

affordances: Provide the actual product-objective solve/work outcome that offline diagnostics must eventually explain or improve.
Support solved/unsolved, budget-edge, stability, regression, and cost-drift joins.
Anchor census/profile/variant associations to current production response.

Stratify failed levels by exhausted/node-capped/work-capped/deadline-truncated via the standard compact failure-response summary (manifest.json's failureEvidence.summary; see docs/solver-failure-evidence-disposition.json), including failed attempts inside an eventually-solved parent.
caveats: A latest pointer is a convenience, not timeless authority; inspect embedded commit/protocol metadata.
Historical results must be reconciled to current code, budget semantics, and identity vocabulary before decision-bearing use.

assets.name: Derived solver capability-memory view and health churn
affordances: Preserve complementary gain/loss capability separately from an experiment's promotion disposition.
Measure overlap, unique current-residual nominations, confirmed current-baseline gains, and capability churn without adding solver compute.
Turn rejected/promoted policy diversity into generic premise nominations for routing, retention, representation, restart, or handoff research.
caveats: Historical signature intersections with a current residual are nomination evidence only; they are not current-code/current-budget capability.
Exact historical level outcomes and capability-memory membership are forbidden production routing inputs.
Candidate rows omitted from a report are unknown, not failures; errors/truncation are inconclusive.
Mining many policies/signatures creates selection pressure and descendant treatments require proportionate independent confirmation.

assets.name: Production attempt lifecycle and allocation telemetry

locations.path: solver-stress-refresh and lifecycle-failure-map reports under reports/stress/

affordances: Show which actions were reached, skipped, starved, exhausted, or continued and how much comparable work they received.
Separate routing/allocation failures from true isolated search-quality failures.
Join live production response to census rescuer value and tranche economics.
caveats: Historical lifecycle telemetry is observational when predecessor state, sequence, or budget differs.
Stage/action identities changed during naming cleanup and must normalize through owning compatibility boundaries.

assets.name: Known-solution-prefix survival observations

locations.path: known-solution-prefix survival captures and analyses selected by investigations

affordances: Locate where known-valid support disappears across generation, prune, dedup, scoring, width cull, and diversity selection.
Distinguish failure to generate viable material from failure to retain or rank it.
Nominate exact-prefix and paired-trace follow-up at a concrete decision boundary.
Project final known-support extinction into a compact parent-level row carrying path/family support immediately before loss for joins with failure/search-loss evidence.
caveats: Known-support extinction is not proof that every true solution is extinct.
Known paths are offline labels and observer mode must preserve search parity.

assets.name: Method probes and bounded operational traces

locations.path: method-probe, paired deterministic trace, and beam-trace outputs selected by investigations

affordances: Explain why two configurations with similar outcomes are operationally different or vice versa.
Locate first deterministic divergence in ordering, pruning, retention, dedup, or branch choice.
Turn an aggregate census/variant anomaly into a concrete recurring mechanism.
caveats: Bounded or truncated traces are censored observations, not proofs of full-search equivalence.
Trace-selected examples are forensic/discovery evidence unless independently sampled.

assets.name: Exact/reference feasibility and explicit-prefix labels

locations.path: CP-SAT/reference probe outputs and committed labelled branch sets under reports/stress/

affordances: Label selected prefixes/states live or dead when the model supports the mechanics and terminates decisively.
Distinguish a ranking/retention mistake from genuine infeasibility.
Provide independent labels for replay probes and reduced counterexamples.
caveats: Timeout and unsupported mechanics are abstentions, not dead/UNSAT labels.
Every model-emitted or pinned witness used as evidence must be reconciled with the canonical referee.
Reference-model support is incomplete and must be checked before interpreting a null.

assets.name: Offline replay atlas of labelled solver states

locations.path: CP-SAT-labelled branch sets and offline-replay outputs under reports/stress/

affordances: Test candidate reasoners against already-labelled real solver states without modifying production search.
Measure dead catches, live false rejects, unique catches, overlap, abstention, and firing depth before buying a live experiment.
Reuse expensive exact labels across multiple narrow hypotheses.
caveats: The atlas is a selected research sample, not automatically representative state-distribution evidence.
A strong replay classifier still needs cost, live solve/work, and independent confirmation before promotion.

assets.name: Controlled variant-family datasets and family index
affordances: Use controlled transformations to localize structural causes of solver cliffs.
Study orientation, density, mechanic, repair, retention, and action-value changes while holding ancestry comparatively fixed.
Test whether census/profile/telemetry associations persist under interventions instead of unrelated-level correlation.
caveats: The large canonical resource is deliberately off main and should be mounted read-only while current code supplies the tools.
Sibling variants are correlated; parent family is the independent unit for broad generalization.
Historical solver observations must be rechecked on current code before promotion.

assets.name: Experiment and family-run manifests

locations.path: manifest artifacts emitted beside decision-bearing solver/family runs

affordances: Recover exactly what code, population, flags, workflow inputs, seeds, budgets, and output produced a result.
Detect invalid A/B comparisons where non-treatment dimensions changed.
Join family observations to solver/data provenance without reconstructing invocation history from filenames.
caveats: Older artifacts may predate current manifest schemas and must remain explicitly historical/unknown where fields are absent.

A valid manifest establishes execution provenance/comparability, not efficacy, population independence, or the inferential role of a corpus. Human/report preflight must still record selection history and inference scope.

assets.name: Tracked raw logs, baselines, and historical run evidence

locations.path: tracked exceptions and historical snapshots classified by logs/artifact-metadata.json

affordances: Recover raw evidence behind dated reports and compare current behavior to historical baselines.
Distinguish current pointers, compatibility baselines, historical snapshots, and source evidence using machine-readable classification.
Support regression attribution when a current aggregate hides which levels or attempts moved.
caveats: logs/Solver is a frozen legacy attic and not a current output destination.
latest pointers are not independent evidence and historical artifacts are not current capability by existence alone.

main's git history for many pre-2026-09-03 tracked files (e.g. scripts/stress/feature-solvability-analysis.mjs, data/levels.json) was squashed into a single 2026-09-03 merge commit -- git log/blame cannot recover when these files actually changed prior to that date. Only a file's own embedded generatedAt/timestamp fields are trustworthy for pre-merge chronology (see reports/2026-09-05-routing-regime-archetype-risk-three-point-refinement-001.md).

assets.name: Machine-readable index of current research authority and prior reports
affordances: Find prior experiments, current decisions, remaining gates, and linked artifacts before rerunning work.
Search historical naming-era stage/routing/attempt vocabulary through current identity normalizers.
Expose evidence that is not already linked from the active workstream narrative.
caveats: The index routes to evidence; it does not replace reading the owning report/artifact.
Legacy reports without structured metadata remain searchable but have weaker machine-readable status.

assets.name: Static level descriptors, heatmaps, and feature analyses

locations.path: feature-solvability, corpus-query, and related descriptor outputs

affordances: Stratify solver outcomes and technique-response cohorts by legal static puzzle descriptors.
Translate offline labels such as solution-profile or census associations into candidate level-blind descriptors.
Identify geometry/mechanic confounds before attributing an outcome difference to a solver mechanism.
caveats: Feature/outcome correlation is nomination evidence, not causal routing evidence.
High-dimensional descriptors can accidentally become identity/family proxies and require held-out confirmation.

assets.name: Failure inbox and curated diagnostic cohorts

locations.path: data/stress/*population.json, *ids.txt, and curated diagnostic selection artifacts

affordances: Preserve which failures were already inspected or selected for a bounded investigation.
Recover selection provenance for targeted cohorts so they are not later misrepresented as random samples.
Route recurring cases toward lifecycle, trace, exact, or variant follow-up.
caveats: Curated cohorts are selected evidence; they cannot estimate population prevalence without a separate sampling design.
Triage state is workflow metadata, not a solver capability label.

assets.name: Compact solver failure-response documents
affordances: Distinguish non-participation, stage exposure, work/dose, censoring/exhaustion, badness support, and failed attempts inside solved controls without retaining full paths/state.
Provide the cheapest parent-aware reconnaissance layer before compact diagnostic observers, rich search-loss capsules, exact annotation, or causal interventions.
Preserve producer-supplied run/protocol identity so protocol-compatible repeated observations can be separated from descriptive-only joins.
caveats: Independent prevalence defaults to parent level; multiple attempts/records from one parent are dependent support observations.
Unknown protocolHash is descriptive only and must not be treated as longitudinally comparable.
Missing fields remain unknown rather than inferred false/zero; configured-but-unreached is not evidence that the mechanism failed.
Compact response records describe execution/outcome mechanics and do not assign causal failure classes or authorize production routing.

assets.name: Search-loss observation capsules for solver attempts
joinKeys: capsule parentId plus canonical level identity/structural revision
affordances: Localize where/why a solver attempt lost search material without a bespoke rerun, once a producer emits captures.
Nominate concrete states/decisions for exact annotation or richer operational-trace replay.
Preserve selector observed/retained/truncated denominators alongside any retained capsule.
caveats: Representative real capture has cleared parity, boundedness, denominator, solved/failed-control, and empirical-conditioning gates; the asset remains catalogue/contract grade until a genuine recurring producer population earns a Resource Contract audit. Synthetic fixtures and one-off canaries do not by themselves promote the asset.
A bounded selector intentionally drops most frontier/event material; absence of a capsule is unknown, not a negative observation.

Independent unit is parent level; within-parent capsules are repeated measures, and solved-run controls are required when the same pruning, culling, or repetition event can occur during successful search.
Offline capsules/annotations are forensic evidence and may not steer production solving.

relationships.join: source runId/workflow to harvested hint/provenance changes and owning experiment evidence
questions: Did this run add genuinely new accepted paths/provenance or mostly rediscover already-represented evidence?
Were missing hint discoveries rejected by the referee, blocked by revision mismatch, or simply absent from the success-selected source artifacts?
Can harvest-selection effects be separated from solver performance effects before interpreting longitudinal hint counts?
relationships.boundary: Harvest manifests describe selection among already-solved candidate rows. They are not attempted-population denominators and cannot support solve-rate or technique-performance claims without the originating run population.

relationships.join: parentId/levelId + exact complete hint path signature + immutable run/protocol/solver identity
questions: Which failed attempts and work preceded discovery of this exact accepted path?
Does a path attributed to a winning technique only appear after characteristic failures or handoffs from earlier attempts?
Can success-selected hint evidence be rejoined to its originating denominator/process context without embedding that context into every Hint record?
relationships.boundary: Exact path equality binds the success to the stored hint; the experiment contract owns protocol/population semantics. Historical process context is offline evidence and does not make the discovery current capability or legal runtime routing.

relationships.join: levelId plus evidence-purpose-filtered provenance source/facets/dependency stratum and, when needed, hint path signature
questions: Is apparent sampled solution-order agreement stable across discovery sources, or source-biased?
Do technique-response cohorts differ by independently supported known-solution modes?
relationships.boundary: Declare solution-atlas or another explicit purpose before selection; raw provenance-event volume is not independent support. Source corroboration can expose sampling bias but does not prove whole-space rigidity or completeness. Offline diagnosis only; provenance/profile labels do not become runtime routing inputs.

relationships.join: levelId plus normalized solver/configuration identity, comparable solver regime, dependency stratum, and comparable work fields
questions: Did the same configuration historically solve this level at materially different work?
Is a current regression/cost cliff likely semantic drift, search drift, or historical protocol mismatch?
Does this historical discovery establish current capability, or only nominate a bounded current replay?
relationships.boundary: Historical rediscovery is nomination/forensic evidence until code/config/scheduler/work comparability is established. Technique-performance claims require the originating attempted population; success-selected hint events alone are insufficient.

relationships.join: canonical level fingerprint / provenance.context.levelRevision
questions: Was this hint/result produced against the same structural revision?
Are apparent duplicate observations actually the same puzzle structure?
relationships.boundary: Use as identity/revision evidence, not a production nearest-neighbor lookup.

relationships.join: corpus + levelId + normalized action/configuration identity
questions: Does production fail because a useful technique is never reached/starved, or because it also fails in isolation?
Which useful work tranches are missing from live allocation?
relationships.boundary: Sequence-dependent isolated capability remains observational until controlled in the production context.

relationships.join: corpus + levelId
questions: Do stable technique niches correspond to supported sampled diversity, turn/portal structure, observed must-cross order agreement, or objective-satisfaction depth?
Can an offline association be translated into a simpler legal level/state descriptor?
relationships.boundary: Profile axes must be support-aware and population selection history must be preserved. Any descriptor selected from these joins is development evidence and requires independent confirmation.

relationships.join: parent/variant level identity mapped to current normalized technique/configuration response
questions: Which controlled structural transformation flips technique value or useful budget depth?
Is a census niche causal/stable within related puzzle neighborhoods?
relationships.boundary: Analyze by parent family and re-run decision-bearing historical outcomes on current code.

relationships.join: parent/variant identity plus matched solver config/ref
questions: Where is the first operational divergence between a solved parent and unsolved close relative?
Does an orientation/density/mechanic cliff originate in legality, ordering, retention, dedup, or randomness?
relationships.boundary: One sibling pair is a mechanism case study; recurrence across unrelated parents is needed for generalization.

relationships.join: levelId + decision depth/prefix + attempt configuration
questions: Was material culled while a live continuation still existed?
Was an extinction event a ranking/retention mistake or genuine infeasibility?
relationships.boundary: Known paths guide offline labeling only; timeout/unsupported exact probes abstain.

relationships.join: labelled branch/state identity
questions: Can a candidate reasoner separate live/dead states before production integration?
Does it add unique catches beyond the existing gauntlet without live false rejects on supported labels?
relationships.boundary: Replay quality does not establish live solve/work value or mathematical soundness beyond tested coverage.

relationships.join: corpus + levelId
questions: Which legal level features stratify current failures or budget-edge solves?
Are solver-response differences confounded by generator batch, geometry, mechanic envelope, or later population selection?
relationships.boundary: Observational feature correlations nominate hypotheses; selected thresholds require held-out confirmation. Selected residuals do not estimate unconditional prevalence.

relationships.join: levelId against a named baseline population/solved-set plus candidate evidence provenance
questions: Which current production misses were solved by a materially different candidate or historical policy?
How much complementary capability remains unique after overlap and freshness are made explicit?
Which accepted production changes displaced previously observed capability?
relationships.boundary: Historical gain intersections are nominations only; current capability requires a comparable current row-level observation. Exact same-level history may not steer production.

relationships.join: nominated policy-response contrast by levelId, then mechanism-specific trace/family/descriptor evidence
questions: Do complementary policies repeatedly preserve different live basins?
Can a historical policy contrast be translated into a compact legal structural/current-solve descriptor or a shared representation/retention premise?
relationships.boundary: Capability-memory membership may select offline research cases but cannot be a runtime feature. A descendant selected from many historical policies is development evidence and needs proportionate confirmation.

relationships.join: runId/experimentId/output artifact plus solver ref and level selection hash
questions: Are two purported A/B arms actually comparable?
Which code/data/protocol produced this result?
Can a historical artifact be safely joined to current evidence?
relationships.boundary: Execution provenance/comparability is necessary but does not establish efficacy, population independence, or inferential entitlement. Preserve selection history separately.

relationships.join: report/artifact paths plus normalized topic/stage/routing/attempt terminology
questions: Has this premise already been tested under an older name?
Which raw artifact or remaining gate sits behind a current decision?
relationships.boundary: Use the index to discover evidence, then read the owning report/artifact before acting.

relationships.join: level + solver ref/config
questions: Did a solve/work regression accompany a deterministic search-order change?
Is a performance change semantic or merely implementation latency?
Did a net-positive production change exchange one solved-set basin for another?
relationships.boundary: Fingerprint differences and churn localize change; they do not by themselves determine whether the change is good or general.

relationships.join: selected corpus + levelId with recorded selection provenance
questions: What is the cheapest next instrument for a recurring failure class?
Can a selected anomaly or displaced capability be converted into a controlled family, trace, or exact-label question?
relationships.boundary: Preserve the selected nature of the cohort; do not use it as prevalence evidence.

relationships.join: levelId + solver/run ref + stage/attempt identity
questions: Did a failed level receive work at the stage where the capsule was observed?
Is a promising capsule merely a side effect of a stage that received negligible work?
relationships.boundary: Lifecycle describes allocation/reach. Search-loss capsules describe selected within-search observations. Neither alone establishes causal first loss.

relationships.join: capsule state/path identity + exact query prefix identity
questions: Is a captured state/prefix feasible (LIVE) or infeasible (DEAD)?
Did a generic cull coincide with loss of exact feasibility?
relationships.boundary: Exact annotation is a downstream, question-driven adapter; timeout/unsupported resolves to UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED and is never forced to a label.

relationships.join: levelId + decision/state identity
questions: Why did two policies diverge around a recurring capsule phenotype?
relationships.boundary: Trace-selected examples remain development/forensic evidence unless separately sampled.

relationships.join: policy/baseline identity + loss-signature/phenotype
questions: Do two policies fail the same level in different observable basins?
Does a treatment move failures from one phenotype to another rather than removing them?
relationships.boundary: Exact level identities remain offline research labels and may not steer production; a loss-signature comparison is a derived view built only after the base resource exists.

relationships.join: parent/variant identity + solver protocol
questions: Does a controlled transformation move the observed loss earlier/later?
Does the same capsule phenotype recur across unrelated parents?
relationships.boundary: Family siblings remain dependent. Independent unit is parent family for cross-family claims.

relationships.join: levelId + technique/configuration identity + cell identity
questions: Do failed technique-census cells preserve compact work/progress/censoring response instead of collapsing to solve/no-solve?
relationships.boundary: The technique census is both a consumer and a primary prospective producer; complete cell denominator remains the census's own responsibility.
